confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Glasgow and UK price levels for July 2026, not from live listings or current menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain because summer demand and rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine were anchored to the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.1x beer, wine glass about 1.5x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. FX as_of_date is 2026-10-15, the latest RBA observation found; the 2026-10-16 figure circulating in third-party sources was not verified against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized UK cities with similar tourist and student demand, such as Manchester, Birmingham and Edinburgh, adjusted to Glasgow's generally lower restaurant and hotel price level. No external sources were used for the city-price anchors.
